target.title: chore(deps): refresh dependency and action pins
target.body:
## Summary

- refresh all policy-eligible direct development dependencies and resolved transitives
- update pnpm to 11.11.0 for lockfile and package-path traversal hardening
- pin checkout, AWS credential configuration, and artifact upload Actions to current immutable release SHAs

## Freshness policy

The repository's 48-hour minimum release age remains enforced. `@cloudflare/workers-types` is capped at `5.20260710.1`; pnpm 11.12.0 is also intentionally held until eligible. Node 22.23.1 and the release-identity-bound OpenClaw appliance pins remain unchanged.

## Validation

- `npx --yes pnpm@11.11.0 check`
  - 157 Node tests passed
  - 20 Worker tests passed
  - 53 AWS tests passed; 4 PostgreSQL integration tests skipped without a configured isolated database
- `npx --yes pnpm@11.11.0 audit --audit-level low`: no known vulnerabilities
- `actionlint .github/workflows/*.yml`
- FakeCo profile validation and CloudFormation YAML parse
- Linux/AMD64 AWS image build and non-root runtime bundle import
- source-blind local UI/API behavior contract
- Public Model Identifier Gate: no model identifier changes
- AutoReview: clean for both dependency/Action and pnpm toolchain changes

No deployment, image publication, release, version bump, tag, registry publish, or GitHub Release is part of this PR. The deployment and publication workflows remain manual `workflow_dispatch` surfaces.
